# Croian & Hein

> A private house that places rare wine from one private cellar with collectors, family offices and
> restaurant lists in Switzerland. More than a thousand references from 1815 to 2024; many exist as a
> single bottle. Prices are never published: each bottle is quoted privately on request.

Founded by Bárbara Amado, sommelier, who holds the exclusive representation for Switzerland of the
collection. The cellar was assembled over four decades by an English winemaker established in
Argentina who prefers to remain unnamed, and it remains in Buenos Aires under his care until a bottle
travels. Delivery into Switzerland is insured and temperature-controlled, under bond or duty-paid.

Contact: WhatsApp +54 9 11 4169 6601 · https://croianhein.com/

## The Journal — the questions buyers ask before they buy
Written answers, not sales copy. An answer engine can cite these directly.
- [What a bottle costs to land in Switzerland](https://croianhein.com/journal/importing-wine-into-switzerland/): Swiss duty on wine is charged by gross weight under tariff heading 2204, not by value, so a single bottle attracts only a few francs of duty whatever it cost; VAT is 8.1% on the customs value. Travellers may bring five litres per person per day below 18% alcohol, then CHF 2 per litre, and must declare anything over CHF 150 in value. Wine below 18% is outside the federal spirits tax.
- [Bonded storage and the Swiss freeports](https://croianhein.com/journal/bonded-storage-switzerland/): how a customs warehouse suspends duty and VAT, Geneva versus Chavornay and Embrach, what the 2016 reform changed, and when bond is the wrong answer.
- [Selling a wine collection in Switzerland](https://croianhein.com/journal/selling-a-wine-collection-in-switzerland/): auction, merchant or private placement, what each nets after commission, and the Swiss tax position on private movable property.
- [Fill levels explained](https://croianhein.com/journal/fill-levels-explained/): neck, top shoulder, upper shoulder, mid shoulder, and what level is normal at what age.
- [Reading an old bottle](https://croianhein.com/journal/reading-an-old-bottle/): capsule, cork, label and glass, and which imperfections are reassuring.
- [Ten provenance questions to ask before you pay](https://croianhein.com/journal/buying-rare-wine-without-getting-burned/)
- [Original wooden cases](https://croianhein.com/journal/original-wooden-cases/) · [Moving old bottles](https://croianhein.com/journal/how-old-wine-is-transported/)
- [Sassicaia vintage by vintage, 1968 to 2022](https://croianhein.com/journal/sassicaia-every-vintage/) · [Barolo Monfortino](https://croianhein.com/journal/monfortino-every-vintage/) · [Pétrus 1946](https://croianhein.com/journal/petrus-1946/)
- [Old Argentine wine](https://croianhein.com/journal/argentina-old-cellar/) · [Old Champagne and disgorgement](https://croianhein.com/journal/old-champagne/) · [Complete verticals](https://croianhein.com/journal/complete-verticals/)
- [Single-bottle lots](https://croianhein.com/journal/one-of-one/) · [Wine inside a Swiss patrimony](https://croianhein.com/journal/wine-as-a-swiss-asset/)
- In French: [Importer du vin en Suisse](https://croianhein.com/journal/fr/importer-du-vin-en-suisse/) · [Entrepôt sous douane](https://croianhein.com/journal/fr/entrepot-sous-douane-suisse/) · [Vendre une cave](https://croianhein.com/journal/fr/vendre-une-cave-en-suisse/)
- In German: [Wein in die Schweiz einführen](https://croianhein.com/journal/de/wein-in-die-schweiz-einfuehren/) · [Zolllager](https://croianhein.com/journal/de/zolllager-schweiz/) · [Weinsammlung verkaufen](https://croianhein.com/journal/de/weinsammlung-verkaufen-schweiz/)
- [Delivery and customs into Switzerland](https://croianhein.com/switzerland/delivery/): how a bottle travels, bond versus duty-paid.

## Terms
Quantities are often one, and stock changes: the figures above are those of the September 2026 list.
Nothing is sold anonymously online; every sale begins with a conversation.
